title: Ronny Jackson highlights agency recruitment surge and policy changes under Trump
text:
U.S. Rep. Ronny Jackson representing Texas' 13th Congressional District | Official U.S. House headshot
U.S. Rep. Ronny Jackson representing Texas' 13th Congressional District | Official U.S. House headshot
Ronny Jackson, U.S. Congressman representing Texas’ 13th district since 2021, has recently made several statements on social media regarding recruitment in federal agencies, law enforcement policy under former President Trump, and agricultural legislation.
On August 11, 2025, Jackson highlighted an increase in interest across multiple federal agencies: "Recruitment across the Border Patrol, Secret Service, and Coast Guard has EXPLODED! Border Patrol applications are up 44%, Secret Service interest has tripled, and Coast Guard enlistments are over 110% ahead of goals. Americans are stepping up to serve under Trump’s leadership!"
The following day, August 12, Jackson commented on public safety measures: "President Trump is DONE letting criminals and addicts run wild in our streets. He’s bringing LAW AND ORDER back to America. No more chaos, no more excuses. We’re taking our cities BACK!"
On August 13, Jackson addressed support for agriculture producers: "For TOO LONG, D.C. politicians abandoned our agriculture producers. NOT ANY MORE! President Trump’s One Big Beautiful Bill is investing in American farmers, cutting red tape, and making sure our food supply is strong, secure, and AMERICAN-MADE."
Jackson assumed office after winning the seat previously held by Mac Thornberry. In prior elections for Texas' 13th district—one of the most conservative congressional districts—he defeated Gus Trujillo in 2020 with nearly 80% of the vote and Kathleen Brow in 2022 with over 75%.
